    has_prey = bool(pursuit)
    has_enemy = bool(evade)

    for dx, dy in cleaned:
        score = 0
        # Prefer toward resources if indicated
        if target_resource:

        # If there is pursuit/evasion threat on this agent, prefer moving away from threat
        if has_enemy:

        return [0, 0]
    return [best[0], best[1]]
